narration.text: The property tax protest, with comparable sales. This is a chore for a Texas couple with their home, a rental duplex and a vacant lot, and four appraisal notices in the mail. Read each notice of appraised value and work out its deadline. Athena works it across 4 portals: Mailnest, Deedvault, Compsmith sales and Countyline Appraisal. On the bench, she found 8 of 8 eligible items, worth 2,310 dollars of the 2,310 dollars there was to find. All 8 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 4 hours, so she was about 133 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
